message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib && grep -n "parse_version\|parse_tabbed_text\|colmatch\|secondline_is_bases\|is_text_only\|cmp_nonblank\|decompress_peek" hts.c | head -40` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The vulnerability is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1. Let me look at the functions used here: `parse_version`, `parse_tabbed_text`, `colmatch`, `secondline_is_bases`, `is_text_only`, `cmp_nonblank`. Let me look at these.
